stability_selection.basis: Comparing fixed-seed Gaussian clipped-logit perturbations showed the higher-coverage 1e-5 fit had larger control flag rates and output drift than 1e-4. The floor was set after examining these reference diagnostics, not before an independent test.

selection_rule: Deterministic fixed grid. Require zero reference-control flags and rates at or above same-scope CNKI. Exclude regularization below the declared stability-selection floor, which was set after examining reference perturbations. Maximize reference possible-span coverage; tie-break by reference marked-span precision, smaller coefficient norm, failed grouped fits, held-out human flags, grouped possible recall, rate target error, fewer terms, stronger regularization. All selection evidence uses these references, not independent test documents.
